sectionRef: Acceptance Criteria — sync.now concurrent error contract
description: sync.now returns 'sync already in progress' for concurrent calls, but the plan AC and README inconsistency require 'another sync in progress' (and the sync-lock diagnostic prose throughout the codebase already uses that exact wording). The current string also diverges from the matching build.ts contract which correctly returns 'another build in progress'.
suggestedFix: Change the AlreadyRunningError branch in sync-now.ts to return { ok: false, error: 'another sync in progress' }; update the assertion in sync-now.test.ts and the README sentence to match.
